title: Test Motion → Trace → Shape on real browsers
objective: Verify the HTML application renders correctly and all controls work across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.
scope: Verify rendering of layout, graphs, and visuals
Test all interactive controls: Play, Pause, Step, time slider, parameter selectors
Identify any rendering or interaction issues
Accept single-setup partial observations while retaining the full task completion criteria
restrictions: Do not modify the HTML or JavaScript
Do not upload the lab or personal data to third-party testing services; optional public repository feedback must follow the privacy guidance in docs/QUICKSTART.md

inputs.name: Motion-Trace-Shape.html
inputs.how_to_access: Download from GitHub or clone repository

inputs.name: Browser observation report
inputs.how_to_access: Copy into plain text or use the prompts on paper

deliverables.name: Browser test report
required_content: Downloaded revision or version, if known
acceptance_criteria: A partial report may cover one browser/device setup; state the limited coverage
Controls are marked worked, partial, did not work or not tested

beneficiaries.name: Learners
beneficiaries.impact: Specific observations help identify device and interaction problems

beneficiaries.name: Educators
beneficiaries.impact: Evidence helps educators judge the stated compatibility limits without implying classroom acceptance

required_skills: Ability to describe what works and doesn't work
required_permissions: Access to one browser or device for a partial observation
stop_conditions: HTML file is corrupted or inaccessible
Testing requires payment or account creation
Testing requires bypassing a security warning, unfamiliar permissions or sharing personal information
how_to_start: Read docs/QUICKSTART.md. Download and open the standalone HTML without Git, or use an existing copy. Record observations from one available setup with the browser report template. Mark untested controls explicitly. A second setup is optional.
how_to_submit: Keep the report locally, or voluntarily paste it into a repository issue with a GitHub account and connection. Experienced contributors may submit a dated docs/test-reports/ file through a fork and pull request. Reference TASK-motion-browser-test without claiming that a partial report closes it.

progress.completed: Headless Chromium and Firefox on Ubuntu 24.04; both editions, controls/downloads, narrow CSS widths and AI screenshot review. SVG fill defect corrected.
progress.remaining: Keep task open for physical-device, Safari/Edge, human visual and assistive-technology acceptance. CI is not a mobile/touch test.

completion_criteria: Partial reports do not close this task or establish cross-browser compatibility
Before closure, maintainers review combined evidence for the requested browser/device coverage, including the remaining physical-device, Safari/Edge, human visual and assistive-technology gaps
A single contributor does not need to supply all coverage
